resources.string: Skip intro, jump to the end of the opening
Look up intro and credits times on TheIntroDB and SkipDB while a video plays. Named chapters in the file work without this.
Intro and credits times: TheIntroDB (theintrodb.org) and SkipDB (skipdb.tv). SkipDB data is made available under the Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0.
Chapter marks and the chapter name on the player\'s seek bar. Skip intro and Skip credits work either way.
